n't find the cause and switched to the hosted `cloud eval run`.\n- **Prompt cases rejected:** the hosted run rejected prompt-based

se.\n- **Server name:** the suite's `target.servers` name had to match the saved project server `Arithmetic`, not the URL.\n- **As
